pk.context: 300 mg oral, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: round, film-coated tablet, color varies by strength

tell: Its active metabolite, norquetiapine, matches it at D2 receptors but is more active at 5-HT2A receptors.

clues.text: Tablets are 100% bioavailable relative to solution, and food only marginally affects absorption. It is 83% protein bound and eliminated mainly by hepatic metabolism; about 73% of a dose is recovered in urine.
A fumarate salt whose active moiety has a molecular weight of 383.5. It is moderately soluble in water.
An NDA tablet in strengths from 25 mg to 400 mg.
Boxed warning for increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis, and for suicidal thoughts. Contraindicated with known hypersensitivity to the drug or its excipients.
Schizophrenia, manic episodes of bipolar I disorder, and depressive episodes of bipolar disorder.
Its action is unclear, but may come from combined dopamine type 2 and serotonin type 2 antagonism.
The generic name begins with Q and has ten letters.
